0022600016.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-4) visit the Boston Celtics (3-1) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, the Bulls' sixth of the season. Chicago is on a three-game losing streak, is 0-2 at home and 1-2 on the road, and sits 4th in the Central, 3 games back, and 12th in the East, while Boston has won three straight, is 3-0 at home, and sits 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and 4th in the East. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), Patrick Williams (groin soreness), and Tobe Awaka (ankle), and Boston is without Devin Carter (illness). The Bulls trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 134-99 loss in Boston earlier this season, and they lost their 2025-26 series with Boston 1-2.
